# subscriptions

Types from PocketBase's Go package `subscriptions`, as JavaScript sees them: you get these objects from [`$app` and the other globals](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase) and from hook events, and call their methods by their JS names (Go's `FindRecordById` is `findRecordById`). The same package in Go: [subscriptions](/docs/reference/go/pocketbase/tools/subscriptions).

## subscriptions.Broker

Broker defines a struct for managing subscriptions clients.

| Member | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `clients()` | <code>(): { [key: string]: any }</code> | Clients returns a shallow copy of all registered clients indexed with their connection id. |
| `chunkedClients()` | <code>(chunkSize: number): Array&lt;Array&lt;<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/subscriptions#subscriptionsclient">Client</a>&gt;&gt;</code> | ChunkedClients splits the current clients into a chunked slice. |
| `totalClients()` | <code>(): number</code> | TotalClients returns the total number of registered clients. |
| `clientById()` | <code>(clientId: string): <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/subscriptions#subscriptionsclient">Client</a></code> | ClientById finds a registered client by its id. |
| `register()` | <code>(client: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/subscriptions#subscriptionsclient">Client</a>): void</code> | Register adds a new client to the broker instance. |
| `unregister()` | <code>(clientId: string): void</code> | Unregister removes a single client by its id and marks it as discarded. |

## subscriptions.Client

Client is an interface for a generic subscription client.

| Member | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `id()` | <code>(): string</code> | Id Returns the unique id of the client. |
| `channel()` | <code>(): undefined</code> | Channel returns the client's communication channel. |
| `subscriptions()` | <code>(...prefixes: string[]): { [key: string]: any }</code> | Subscriptions returns a shallow copy of the client subscriptions matching the prefixes. If no prefix is specified, returns all subscriptions. |
| `subscribe()` | <code>(...subs: string[]): void</code> | Subscribe subscribes the client to the provided subscriptions list. |
| `unsubscribe()` | <code>(...subs: string[]): void</code> | Unsubscribe unsubscribes the client from the provided subscriptions list. |
| `hasSubscription()` | <code>(sub: string): boolean</code> | HasSubscription checks if the client is subscribed to `sub`. |
| `set()` | <code>(key: string, value: any): void</code> | Set stores any value to the client's context. |
| `unset()` | <code>(key: string): void</code> | Unset removes a single value from the client's context. |
| `get()` | <code>(key: string): any</code> | Get retrieves the key value from the client's context. |
| `discard()` | <code>(): void</code> | Discard marks the client as "discarded" (and closes its channel), meaning that it shouldn't be used anymore for sending new messages. |
| `isDiscarded()` | <code>(): boolean</code> | IsDiscarded indicates whether the client has been "discarded" and should no longer be used. |
| `send()` | <code>(m: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/subscriptions#subscriptionsmessage">Message</a>): void</code> | Send sends the specified message to the client's channel (if not discarded). |

## subscriptions.Message

Message defines a client's channel data.

| Member | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | <code>string</code> |  |
| `data` | <code>string&#124;Array&lt;number&gt;</code> |  |
| `writeSSE()` | <code>(w: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/io#iowriter">io.Writer</a>, eventId: string): void</code> | WriteSSE writes the current message in a SSE format into the provided writer. |
